_about: HO-040 Russian Roster Roulette (CC-010: no people). World units are metres; the felt is at y 0.75, the revolver lies at the table centre, Daniel's easel is LEFT (x negative), Nik's is RIGHT. Edit these numbers when a picture layer drops into assets/; no code change needed.

room.note: 16:9 marble cafe plate (Nik 29 Oct); replaces the 3D back wall. floorCut = fraction of the picture height hidden under the 3D floor so the counter base meets the floor line

gunTop.note: top-down revolver photo with alpha, barrel pointing UP in the picture; laid flat on the felt for the top-down spin shots and cross-faded with the 3D model at the camera cut. length = barrel-to-grip size in metres, offsetZ shifts the picture along the barrel so the muzzle lines up with the model's muzzle (0.19 m ahead of the cylinder axis), rotation in radians if the picture is not straight

flash.note: additive sprite at the muzzle; procedural flash until it exists

revolver.note: spins on the world Y axis; stops with the barrel on the target bubble (horizontal aim), slides back along the barrel line on a shot

hand.note: gloved hand holding the revolver, black background keyed out in code; muzzle = where the flash sits (u from left, v from bottom)

sfx_note: HO-047 (Team G r87 lead, 29 Oct 2026): made in-house, synthesised by assets/sfx/make_sfx.py (numpy; no samples or third-party recordings). WAV, not MP3, so every cue lands on its frame (MP3 adds ~25 ms of encoder silence). handUp and roomTone are the two extras; roomTone is a seamless 24 s loop at 22.05 kHz. A listed file replaces the synthesized cue of that name; the page loads every entry, so keep only sound names in "sfx".
